title: Reviewer findings (PRD §7, FR-5.2)
description: Structured output of an adversarial review step. The `findings` array is normative per PRD §7. `open_questions` and `summary` are P4 schema additions (BOOTSTRAP-NOTES #5): reviewers naturally emit questions that are not claims, and forcing them through the verdict enum is wrong — they get their own slot and the triager handles them first-class. The PRD §7 excerpt itself is unchanged. Strict-mode note (pinned, codex 0.139.0): native structured output requires EVERY property in `required`, so §7-optional fields are spelled required-but-nullable; `suggested_fix: null` means 'none offered'. Ensemble note (pipeline-effectiveness FR-1.2 / review F-007): this file is the PERSISTED findings-record validation schema. `source`/`lens`/`duplicate_of`/`sources` are engine/merge-annotated — NEVER emitted by a reviewer agent's strict structured output (the engine stamps source/lens per panel member and the deterministic merge writes duplicate_of/sources). They are therefore OPTIONAL here (a legacy or single-reviewer artifact that omits them validates), and are stripped out of the strict per-member output schema handed to the reviewer adapter (see `cycle._reviewer_output_schema`), so the reviewer's pinned strict-mode shape is unchanged and a one-member artifact is byte-identical to pre-ensemble output.

id.description: Stable finding ID, e.g. F-001; referenced by triage and confirm verdicts. Engine-synthesized findings (e.g. a reviewer-mutation record) carry suffixed IDs like F-R1-MUTATION.

category.description: Finding category. `behavioral` (pipeline-effectiveness FR-2.4, P4) is an ADDITIVE enum member for findings a verifier raises by *executing* the deliverable (a signal class no diff reader produces); it migrates in with every category-enforcing consumer (cycle merge, triage, confirm, metrics) at once so a behavioral finding can never reach an unmigrated consumer. Pre-migration findings using only the original categories still validate; a `category` outside this enum fails validation closed (never coerced or dropped).

suggested_fix.description: Optional per §7 — null when the reviewer offers none.

source.description: Engine-stamped ensemble annotation (FR-1.2): the panel member's profile that raised this finding. Absent on a single-reviewer / legacy artifact.

lens.description: Engine-stamped ensemble annotation (FR-1.2): the lens fragment id assigned to the member that raised this finding. Absent on a single-reviewer / legacy artifact.

duplicate_of.description: Merge annotation (FR-1.2): the primary finding id this finding deduplicated into, or null/absent for a primary. Only primaries reach triage.

sources.description: Merge annotation (FR-1.2, on a merged primary): every panel-member profile whose finding merged into this primary (including the primary's own).

open_questions.description: Questions, not claims (BOOTSTRAP-NOTES #5). Triage treats each as data and may convert one into a finding.
